title: Select Works of Porphyry
author: Porphyry (Taylor trans)
description: A selection of Porphyry's writings in Thomas Taylor's translation. The collection introduces a major Neoplatonic thinker's approach to philosophy, religious interpretation and the disciplined life of the soul.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB). Source text obtained from Project Gutenberg (https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/77014).
